articles.title: ISRO successfully conducts second integrated air drop test for Gaganyaan mission
articles.summary: ISRO successfully conducted the second integrated air drop test (IADT-02) for the Gaganyaan mission at Sriharikota. This crucial test validates the crew module's recovery systems, vital for ensuring astronaut safety during re-entry and landing. Such advancements underscore India's growing self-reliance in space technology and strengthen its position as a major spacefaring nation, showcasing national capability.

articles.title: This Week’s Most Popular Articles
articles.summary: Russia has reportedly deployed six submarines to the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz amidst escalating geopolitical tensions. This significant military move comes as President Trump issues threats against Iran, highlighting increased regional instability. The deployment underscores Russia's strategic presence in a critical chokepoint, potentially influencing dynamics between major global powers and Iran.

articles.title: Actor Madhavan amazed by Homi Bhabha's vision 70 years ago as India enters new nuclear era on journey towards energy independence
articles.summary: Actor R Madhavan utilized social media to highlight India's significant nuclear milestones, drawing attention to Dr. Homi Bhabha's visionary long-term strategy. This initiative effectively merged cinema and science, raising public awareness about the nation's progress in nuclear energy and technology. It underscores the critical role of indigenous scientific leadership in bolstering national development and strategic capabilities for aspiring officers.

articles.title: ‘Good Sex’: Secret to Hal & Lois’ Long Marriage in Malcolm in the Middle Revealed
articles.summary: Actors Bryan Cranston and Jane Kaczmarek, known as Hal and Lois from 'Malcolm in the Middle', recently discussed the secret behind their characters' popular on-screen marriage. Their insights come as anticipation builds for a potential revival of the beloved television series. This news offers fans a deeper look into the enduring legacy of the show and its iconic stars.
